text:
if you're going to try, go all the way.

otherwise, don't even start.

if you're going to try, go all the way.

this could mean losing girlfriends,

wives,

relatives,

jobs and,

maybe your mind.

go all the way.

this could mean not eating for 3 or 4 days.

this could mean freezing on a park bench.

this could mean jail.

this could mean mockery, derision, loneliness...

loneliness is a gift.

the others are a test of your persistence, or

of how much you really want to do it.

and you will do it,

despite rejection and the disadvantages,

and it will be better than anything you imagined.

if you're going to try, go all the way.

there is no other feeling like that.

you will be alone with the gods

and the nights will blaze with fire.

do it, do it, do it.

do it.

all the way,

all the way.

you will ride life straight to the perfect laugh.

it is the only good fight there is.

translation.title: Roll the Dice
translation.editorial_note: Translated from the supplied Spanish version attributed to Charles Bukowski. Its repeated imperative and short free-verse lines are retained.
